messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired for service `inference-serving-prod` -> Alert ID PDR-2245003456. Severity: P1. Trigger: 5xx spike from edge (avg 12m error rate > 4%). Paging escalation policy: `support-primary` (notified).

maria: I didn't get a page. i'm oncall though — checked my phone. :thinking:

kai: same, my phone silent. I see PD shows the alert routed to `external-contractors-oncall` (weird).

ash: acked incorrectly. I got the page (contractor rotation) and forwarded into this thread. I only saw "inference-serving-prod" in the PD summary, no custom tags.

june: who owns the PD -> rotation bindings? I can jump in to re-route.

sre-rotation-bot: Rotation change detected: `external-contractors-oncall` is active. No recent manual edits recorded. (last IaC deploy: infra/teams/pagerduty@deploy-20240321).

maria: this looks like the escalation policy binding for `inference-serving-prod` was pointing to `support-primary` but `support-primary` had an escalation rule that forwarded to `external-contractors-oncall` if `override=true`. that toggle shouldn't be true.

kai: pulling PD service mapping now.

kai: ```
# pd-cli service get inference-serving-prod --fields escalation_policy,integrations
{
  "id": "svc_89f...",
  "name": "inference-serving-prod",
  "escalation_policy": "escp_support_primary",
  "integrations": ["prometheus", "cloudwatch"]
}
# pd-cli escalation get escp_support_primary --fields rules
[
  { "rule": "primary -> support-oncall" },
  { "rule": "if override=true -> external-contractors-oncall" }
]
```

ash: where did `override=true` come from? there was a one-off patch last week to route some infra alerts to contractors during a maintenance window. maybe never reverted.

june: confirm: the last infra maintenance runbook shows a temporary escalation toggle added by @ops-admin on 2025-02-12 to route infra alerts. guess it leaked into production escalation policy.

maria: mitigation plan: 1) remove the `override=true` rule from `escp_support_primary` 2) re-route the current alert to the correct oncall 3) silence additional duplicate alerts 4) assess customer impact and timeline.

ash: i'm removing the rule now in PD UI (manual). will post updates.

ash: done — removed override rule. Escalation policy now points only to support-oncall. :white_check_mark:

sre-rotation-bot: Escalation policy updated by ash at 2245003782 (UI). Audit ID: AUD-8821.

kai: re-triggering a synthetic alert to validate routing. sending test alert via prometheus -> pd integration.

incident-bot: Test alert generated: PDR-2245003783 -> Routed to support-oncall. Notified: maria, kai.

maria: got the test page. confirming oncall path fixed.

ash: reassigning live alert (PDR-2245003456) to support-oncall and un-assigning contractor. making note on the PD incident.

ash: added note: "Misrouted due to temporary escalation override left in policy. Recovered — routing corrected."

june: now to the customer impact: initial spikes caused ~7% of requests to inference-serving-prod to time out over a 14m window. retries reduced throughput; some customers saw 502s. logs show error bursts between 09:13-09:27 UTC.

kai: pulled logs from edge: ```
2026-03-14T09:13:02Z inference-edge request_id=abc123 status=502 upstream_err=503 timeout_ms=12000
2026-03-14T09:15:10Z inference-edge request_id=def456 status=502 upstream_err=504 timeout_ms=15000
```

maria: customer-facing impact: a handful of paying customers reported degraded responses in monitoring; CS already opened ticket CS-9023. recommending we send a short incident note: what happened, mitigation, ETA (postmortem).

ash: ack. i'll draft interim status and post to #support and email CS.

june: root cause summary so far: temporary escalation override added during maintenance leaked into production escalation policy, causing pages to go to the wrong rotation (contractors). That delayed routing to primary support by ~7 minutes while contractor acked then forwarded. During that window errors accumulated causing customer-visible 502s.

maria: timeline for handoff: i'm oncall for 1 more hour, then kai takes over. i'll add the PD incident to the handoff notes.

kai: i'll take over in an hour. for now i've started a short-term autoscaling bump to reduce error rate (scaled inference pool +2). monitoring shows errors dipping.

ash: created ticket INF-5678 in infra backlog to add a safety check: prevent escalation policy rules with `override` flags from being applied unless reviewed by two approvers. will also add an IaC lint rule to catch this.

june: follow-ups: 1) CS email draft (ash) 2) PD escalation policy IaC patch PR (kai) 3) pipeline gate to detect temporary overrides (maria) 4) postmortem in ops-docs with timeline + remediation (june).

maria: small note — add an automated test in our CI that runs a simulated alert and validates the final notified list contains only allowed rotations for that service. we had this gap.

ash: agreed. i'll attach the audit logs to the PD incident and mark as mitigated. moving to monitoring -> watch.

incident-bot: Alert PDR-2245003456 status: mitigated by ash at 2245003920.

maria: thanks everyone. i'll prepare the oncall handoff message and post at 2245007500 before i sign off. :pray:
